FINDING: Chimaji Appa was the younger brother of Bajirao Peshwa of the Maratha Empire.

Balaji Vishwanath, the father of Chimaji Appa, served as an accountant for the Maratha general Dhanaji Jadhav at Janjira between 1699 and 1702. When Dhanaji Jadhav died, Balaji proved himself as an honest and able officer and went over to the newly released Maratha ruler Chhatrapati Shahu who took note of his abilities and appointed Balaji as his assistant ("c."1708).
